name: Ready Maid
summary:
A Playstation port of a PC adult visual novel, however with all the adult content removed, and come with jewel-size included Princess Magazine (ぷり☆まが) booklet which features maid illustrations and sketches.
You lost your mother in an accident and are living with your father who is a robot engineer. One day, your father is hired to build a maid robot so he decides to create a prototype and leave it with you for a month. During that time, you are tasked to teach the robot all manner of new things, and pass all the information to your father so he can perfect the maid model prototype.
